scope: Component presence, applicability, linkage, version lineage, dependency preservation, and stage readiness for edited-volume chapters.
authority_policy: MWM authority tiers 1-5; generic or publisher exemplars cannot create an MWM gate.

rules.title: Apply the highest applicable MWM authority
rules.assertion: When sources conflict, record the conflict and use the highest applicable MWM contract, guidance, approved volume decision, or release policy.

rules.title: Do not import exemplar requirements silently
rules.assertion: A publisher checklist, template, JATS exemplar, or generic model expectation can raise a question but cannot create a required MWM component without an approved profile decision.

rules.title: Block missing gate preconditions
rules.assertion: A run must have chapter, volume, version, stage, profile, upstream-status, protected-record, open-item-owner, and signatory information before a defensible stage gate can run.
forbidden_claims: generic checklist substitutes for missing profile

rules.title: Load a versioned component profile
rules.assertion: Requiredness, applicability, owners, due stages, delegated rules, accessibility target, and release effects must come from a versioned MWM component profile.

rules.title: Require explicit conditional activation
rules.assertion: Every conditional component must have an activation condition, applicability result, rationale, and profile authority before it can close as not_applicable.

rules.title: Name delegated owners
rules.assertion: A delegated rule must name the responsible owner, authority, due stage, and evidence expected from that owner.

rules.title: Use stable component identifiers
rules.assertion: Every component, object, evidence record, file, and dependency must have a stable identifier or an explicit unresolved status.

rules.title: Keep status dimensions separate
rules.assertion: Present, complete, verified, approved, accessible, cleared, and ready are distinct states; a presence check cannot promote one state into another.

rules.title: Manifest the current package
rules.assertion: The package manifest must identify current files, version IDs, declared purposes, clean/comment state, hashes or stable identifiers, and superseded records where available.

rules.title: Block ambiguous current-file selection
rules.assertion: When multiple files could be current and no authoritative manifest or decision identifies one, the relevant handoff is blocked.

rules.title: Preserve superseded and duplicate history
rules.assertion: Superseded, duplicate, unknown, and prior-version files remain represented and excluded from the current handoff only through recorded status; they are not silently deleted.
forbidden_claims: duplicate can be deleted without record

rules.title: Reconcile identity and metadata records
rules.assertion: Compare title, authors, affiliations, contact, identifiers, order, and version across manuscript, metadata, TOC, filename, forms, and approved decisions; report mismatches without choosing one.
forbidden_claims: model-selected title or author list is authoritative

rules.title: Do not invent metadata
rules.assertion: Missing email, biography, abstract, keyword, identifier, source line, or other metadata is reported or routed; it is never generated or inferred by readiness review.

rules.title: Track later-stage metadata without premature blocking
rules.assertion: A field due at a later stage may remain tracked with an owner and due stage when the current profile does not make it an early-stage blocker.

rules.title: Apply profile-scoped structural requirements
rules.assertion: Required sections, appendices, boxes, notes, references, and supplements are checked only when activated by the chapter profile and type.
forbidden_claims: generic chapter structure is universally required

rules.title: Separate structure presence from structural correctness
rules.assertion: CPR reports presence and relationships; Technical Editing or an authorized owner decides heading hierarchy, numbering, semantics, and structural correctness.
forbidden_claims: heading exists means hierarchy is correct

rules.title: Reconcile callouts to objects and assets
rules.assertion: Every figure, table, box, media, or supplementary callout must have a target object and asset record or an explicit not-applicable/exception rationale.
forbidden_claims: orphan callout is acceptable without decision

rules.title: Link visual companion records
rules.assertion: Applicable visual objects link caption, notes, source line, permission, alt text, technical status, and owner records; presence does not certify their content.
forbidden_claims: caption exists means visual is correct

rules.title: Require linked rights evidence when activated
rules.assertion: Applicable third-party objects have a permission record, license/rights evidence, source line, or approved no-permission rationale linked to the exact object and current version.

rules.title: Do not decide legal sufficiency
rules.assertion: CPR reports missing, ambiguous, expired, or superseded rights evidence and routes legal sufficiency to the rights owner; it does not decide fair use, ownership, license interpretation, or infringement.

rules.title: Consume upstream citation and technical status
rules.assertion: CPR records whether expected citation, reference, link, and cross-reference components and targets exist, while preserving RCI and TE statuses, owners, and findings.
forbidden_claims: complete references prove citations are correct

rules.title: Do not duplicate substantive checks
rules.assertion: CPR does not duplicate APA construction, DOI verification, source-status adjudication, or deep cross-reference semantics owned by RCI or TE.

rules.title: Activate conditional declaration and supplement gates
rules.assertion: Funding, conflict, ethics, consent, data, code, software, AI, permissions, contributor, acknowledgment, and supplement records are checked when profile conditions activate them.

rules.title: Require declared accessibility target and owner
rules.assertion: Accessibility readiness records the configured target, owner, relevant object fields, and specialized review evidence or its explicit not-run state.

rules.title: Do not claim accessibility conformance from presence
rules.assertion: Alt text, table headers, meaningful links, or a structured metadata map may support preparation, but WCAG or structured-content conformance requires appropriate specialized review and authority.

rules.title: Report both sides of a mismatch
rules.assertion: Every cross-file mismatch records both observed records, affected component IDs, comparison basis, owner, and next action.

rules.title: Do not silently repair package conflicts
rules.assertion: CPR does not choose titles, authors, file versions, asset numbering, duplicate deletion, metadata values, or cross-file targets without authority and a recorded decision.

rules.title: Map gaps to their due stage
rules.assertion: Current-stage blockers are distinguished from later-stage tracked items using the profile, risk, and release effect; later requirements do not block early gates without authority or material risk.
forbidden_claims: all future fields are current blockers

rules.title: Preserve material upstream blockers
rules.assertion: A package that is component-complete is not ready when an applicable high-risk RCI, TE, Copyediting, or SEI dependency remains unresolved.

rules.title: Require human sign-off for release
rules.assertion: CPR may recommend a release state and assemble evidence, but a named human signatory must authorize handoff or release unless MWM explicitly delegates that authority.
